news.title: Two Delta planes involved in near miss at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport
news.summary: The FAA is investigating a near miss between two Delta Air Lines flights at Atlanta's Hartsfield-Jackson airport.

news.title: Driver flags down officer near I-285 ramp after passenger shot
news.summary: A motorist flagged down a DeKalb County police officer on Tuesday after a passenger in his vehicle was shot during an argument, officials said.

news.title: 13-year-old boy dies of gunshot wound in Atlanta's English Avenue neighborhood
news.summary: Details were limited early Tuesday as police investigate a scene on Lindsay Street.

news.title: Man arrested after attempting to grab children at Delk Road gas station
news.summary: Marietta police arrested Jerahn Tucker after video captured him trying to snatch two children at a Shell station on Delk Road.

news.title: Duluth police arrest man wanted in Texas after tasing him
news.summary: A man wanted out of Texas was arrested in Duluth after being tased by officers during a brief foot chase early Tuesday morning, according to police.

news.title: DOJ: Man whose gun went off on MARTA bus in Sandy Springs was not legally in the country and is facing federal charge
news.summary: Federal prosecutors say Guillermo Cruz Velazquez, 53, is being charged with unlawful possession of a firearm by an alien illegally or unlawfully present in the U.S.

news.title: Burglary suspect barricaded in Clayton County, two others in custody
news.summary: Clayton County Police say officers are working to apprehend a third burglary suspect in an incident Tuesday on Rock Cut Road.
